Three root license texts remain uncaptured: `EnvCommons/ReasoningGym`, `coder-qicao/RL4GLUE`, and `kbwal/rl-next-tokens`. Their recorded complete pinned trees have no root path containing LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE, and the pinned root LICENSE requests returned404. This is an evidence gap, not a legal conclusion about every file.

Three existing root notices were also retained: Reasoning Gym RU `NOTICE.txt`, verl `Notice.txt`, and Multiple-Solution-TTRL `Notice.txt`. URL, commit, HTTP outcome, SHA256, and available retained-tree Git blob checks are recorded in the delivery validation file `license-evidence.json`.

The selected Reasoning Gym and HELM license copies remain in their original frozen paths. This directory adds no overall license for the student-authored project.
